title: Sea Lions in Newport, Oregon
author: Steven Pavlov
changes: California sea lions (Zalophus californianus) barking on the docks at Newport, Oregon; audio track of a video. Trimmed to 19.90–22.65 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. No high-pass: the excerpt has no measured low-frequency rumble.
